Workflow.Name: pe210308_13
Workflow.Description: CHIMERYS-based label-free quantification workflow. This workflow supports ion trap HCD or ion trap CID MS/MS. The Top N Peaks Filter has been added to prefilter MS/MS spectra prior to the CHIMERYS search. Removal of the Top N Peaks Filter from the workflow will produce poorer results. Please add FASTA databases to the Spectrum Files RC and CHIMERYS Identification nodes before running the workflow. Also, please check the CHIMERYS Identification node to make sure fixed alkytlation is selected, the Prediction Model is chosen, and any dynamic modification is selected.
